results.title: NestJS 12 + TypeORM 1 on in-memory SQLite, tested with @nestjs/testing
results.summary: A NestJS module with a TypeORM entity, repository-backed service and controller, wired to in-memory SQLite and tested end to end through the Nest app with supertest. Install uses --legacy-peer-deps because TypeORM 1.1 still peers on better-sqlite3 ^12, but the driver passes its tests against better-sqlite3 13.

results.title: Flask-SQLAlchemy models with Flask-Migrate upgrades on sqlite in tests

results.title: Generate TypeScript types from JSON Schema with json-schema-to-typescript
results.summary: Compile JSON Schemas into TypeScript interfaces with json-schema-to-typescript, covering required and optional fields, enums, $ref definitions, descriptions as JSDoc and strict additionalProperties.

results.title: preact render to string SSR
results.summary: Server-render preact components with preact-render-to-string, covering props, useState initial values, conditional output, keyed lists and dangerouslySetInnerHTML while asserting exact escaped HTML offline.

results.title: Zod 4 schemas to an OpenAPI 3.1 document with zod-to-openapi
results.summary: Register Zod 4 schemas, path and query parameters, security schemes and routes in an OpenAPIRegistry and generate an OpenAPI 3.1 document (JSON and YAML) from the same schemas used for runtime validation, tested offline.

results.title: jsdiff unified patches: create, apply with fuzz, reverse and word diff
results.summary: Create unified diffs with the diff package, apply them (with fuzz for drifted sources), reverse a patch, count added/removed lines and render word-level diffs.

results.title: jscodeshift rename and require-to-import transform
results.summary: Run jscodeshift programmatically with the tsx parser to rename an imported identifier and its usages and to convert require calls into ES imports, asserting exact output source offline.
